Question Text: Laudato Si emphasizes that we are stewards or guardians of Creation and one another.
A genuine ecological approach always becomes a social approach.
Authentic Development must be understood solely in economic terms.
The apex of Development is exercising the right and duty to seek God.
The problem of climate change is hopeless because humans cannot make a new start.
Social and environmental crises should be addressed separately because they are unrelated.
Dominion over Creation signifies imaging Gods wisdom and love in caring for Creation.
Authentic Development means following the will of God in taking care of our brethren.
Living a simple life is part of being human and one way to show care for the environment.
The duty to provide adequate housing for people experiencing poverty rests only with the government.
Discernment means asking what one is called to do with life.
Vocation is a path guiding efforts and actions toward service to others.
Becoming a saint is a solitary task that can be achieved away from the community.
A good life is measured by entertainment pleasure diversion and escape from worldly things.
Part of discernment is asking who we are and what our life purpose is.
